course_name_original: UE Management de projet en entreprise

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with the essential behaviors and techniques of project management.
Better understand and integrate into the world of business or research through knowledge acquisition and supervised practice of project mode.
Manage content, cost, time, quality, purchasing, risks, and communication in a project.

assessment_methods.method: group project presentation to a jury

assessment_rules: Validation of the work accomplished is done by group, through the presentation of the project before a jury and individually through a continuous assessment in the form of a QCM.
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
